scenario: Research and engineering share an evaluation burst, but samples are drawn independently by team and day.
mechanism: Marginal distributions remain plausible while common-tail company-period risk is erased.
detection: Compare cross-team/cross-date residual dependence and shared-burst event scores; verify path IDs survive transformations.
response: Use aligned joint residual blocks or a qualified dependence model; withhold company risk if unsupported.
test_assertion: Construct two $100/p=0.1 teams: independence gives P(total>150)=0.01, perfect co-burst gives 0.10; aggregator preserves assigned joint law.
residual_limit: Observed correlations cannot identify a never-seen shared extreme.
requirement_source: master plan §3 projections handoff; frontend §company/team overview

scenario: Two mostly zero days each show a daily p95 of zero and the UI adds p95 values.
mechanism: Quantiles do not commute with temporal or entity summation.
detection: Inspect whether period quantiles are computed from period distributions/complete paths rather than displayed component quantiles.
response: Aggregate each path or fit/calibrate the total directly.
test_assertion: Two independent $100 bursts each with p=.04 have daily p95=0 and two-day p95=100; total is not zero.
residual_limit: Even correct aggregation inherits the path model assumptions.
requirement_source: master plan §3 supported uncertainty; frontend financial meaning acceptance

scenario: Twenty daily forecasts of one month end are treated as twenty independent calibrated monthly outcomes.
mechanism: Repeated targets and overlapping sums inflate apparent calibration sample size and precision.
detection: Track target-period IDs, overlap matrix, distinct mature periods and evaluation clustering.
response: Preserve all forecast rows but report dependent evidence and group evaluation uncertainty by target/origin structure.
test_assertion: Duplicating origins for an unchanged terminal target does not increase distinct-target count or narrow an IID evidence interval.
residual_limit: Nonoverlapping periods may still share regimes.
requirement_source: master plan forecast research TBDs; original transcript weekly/monthly comparison

scenario: A long 30-day horizon is recalibrated tomorrow using a partially settled invoice.
mechanism: Incomplete target is mislabeled as a low-spend final outcome, causing downward interval adaptation.
detection: Pending-score queue keyed by target end, financial basis, maturity and truth version.
response: Update only when declared target maturity is met; keep provisional evaluation separately.
test_assertion: Partial invoice does not complete a mature-total residual or update that target calibrator; mature arrival updates it once.
residual_limit: Maturity rules may miss later corrections.
requirement_source: backend coverage/origin requirements; frontend delayed data cannot become zero

scenario: Provider restates a large burst after an ACI update and the new invoice triggers a second update.
mechanism: One outcome is counted twice; calibrator state depends on connector retry order.
detection: Version each outcome and maintain consumed-score/update ledger.
response: Replace evidence through deterministic replay or a justified versioned correction; retain operational and restated metrics.
test_assertion: Replaying identical source revisions produces same final calibration state; forecast artifact remains immutable.
residual_limit: Replay policy itself needs validation after historical revisions.

scenario: High-spend bursts take longer to settle, while calibration includes only quickly settled normal days.
mechanism: Complete-case selection changes the score distribution and hides the right tail.
detection: Compare reported/mature delay by spend/activity strata; expose outstanding coverage and value estimates.
response: Evaluate delay-aware nowcast and maturity policies; degrade risk availability when pending coverage is material.
test_assertion: Synthetic delayed-burst fixture shows missing targets as pending, never zero, and qualification checks see selection imbalance.
residual_limit: Unreported activity cannot be fully quantified without another signal.
requirement_source: master plan measured/estimated coverage; backend source completeness

scenario: Eighteen calibration scores are used to claim a finite unrestricted 95% split-conformal bound; infinities are capped to fit a chart.
mechanism: Rank exceeds calibration size and UI capping silently destroys the stated construction.
detection: Check finite-sample rank, boundary alpha and infinite interval status before serialization.
response: Return unbounded/insufficient-evidence state and keep point/actual values if available.
test_assertion: At n=18 and alpha=.05 rank=19; no finite empirical rank is substituted; infinite bounds do not serialize as zero.
residual_limit: Nineteen scores permit a finite bound but do not prove practical accuracy or independence.

scenario: A nonnegative gross-spend forecast is reused for net charges after a refund and cumulative paths are forcibly monotone.
mechanism: Financial-basis mismatch removes legitimate negative revisions and can falsely mark overspend certain.
detection: Carry gross/net and component basis through model/forecast/budget comparison; detect negative charge categories.
response: Separate gross usage and credits or use a net model with appropriate support; reconcile once.
test_assertion: A refund fixture is retained in net totals; gross-model support checks do not overwrite the refund or declare terminal exceedance certain.
residual_limit: Future discretionary credits can remain unpredictable.
requirement_source: master plan fixed/included/variable distinction and financial unit requirements

scenario: An approved research launch has 0.9 extraction confidence and is presented as 90% probability of an expensive launch.
mechanism: Semantic confidence is substituted for event probability; scenario weights fabricate a predictive mixture.
detection: Require distinct provenance for scenario occurrence weights, extraction confidence and conditional spend distributions.
response: Return scenario-conditioned totals; leave unconditional risk unavailable when weights are unknown.
test_assertion: Changing extraction confidence alone never changes numeric scenario occurrence weights or unconditional spend probability.
residual_limit: Approved plans can still be cancelled; defensible weights may never be available.
requirement_source: Factory plans versus guaranteed events; no invented numerical multipliers

scenario: A new provider/project is compared with a heavily recency-weighted residual pool containing no extreme bursts.
mechanism: Small effective support plus changed conditional law makes narrow weighted intervals look adapted while tail mass disappears.
detection: Report weight concentration, mature-tail counts, provider/project shift and subgroup coverage; test shared-burst scenarios.
response: Compare broader pooling, explicit tail challengers and unweighted stress cases; qualify or withhold tail probability.
test_assertion: Fixture with identical ordinary marginals and a new shared-burst regime triggers an unsupported-tail state despite many Monte Carlo draws.
residual_limit: No retrospective estimator identifies unannounced paradigm changes reliably.
requirement_source: master plan no claim to predict every adoption change; frontend uncertain outcomes
